# row; `budget` caps added+deleted lines vs upstream (`*` = unbounded, for
# generated or fork-owned paths). Raise a budget only in a reviewed commit and
# remove a row in the same commit that removes its patch. Rows of class
# `generated` never go stale. First matching row wins.
